record.paper_title: On some open problems in reliability theory
record.original_question: For Su's 1997 system of supplementary-variable equations for a two dissimilar unit system with three modes and random checks, with state probabilities p0,0,k(x,t), p1,0,0(x,t), p0,1,0(x,t), p1,1,0(x,t), p0,1,1(x,t), p1,0,1(x,t), p0,2,0(x,t), p2,0,0(x,t), p1,1,1(x,t), p1,2,0(x,t), and p2,1,0(x,t); transition rates lambda1,0, lambda2,0, lambda0,1, lambda0,2; check rate alpha(x); and repair rates mu_i,0(x), mu_0,i(x), and mu_i,j(x), determine whether the full PDE system is well posed and determine the asymptotic behavior of its time-dependent solution.

evidence.quote: Where lambda1,0 is the failure rate of unit 1 from normal to partial failure; lambda2,0 is the failure rate of unit 1 from partial failure to total failure; lambda0,1 is the failure rate of unit 2 from normal to partial failure; lambda0,2 is the failure rate of unite 2 from partial failure to total failure; alpha(x) is the check rate satisfying alpha(x) >= 0 and its integral over [0, infinity) is infinity; mu_i,0(x) and mu_0,i(x) are repair rates for the two units; mu_i,j(x) is the repair rate when both units require repair.
Well-posedness of the system of the above equations and asymptotic behavior of its time-dependent solution have not been obtained until now.

artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution was found. The problem is stated as open in a recent survey of open problems in reliability theory, and a targeted web search did not return any paper establishing well-posedness or the asymptotic behavior of this specific supplementary-variable system for the two-dissimilar-unit, three-mode, random-check model.
